docs.summary: The shop's opening: a room picture, rooms to shop by, popular products and the members' offer.
docs.narrow: The opening stacks its picture under the words; rooms and products drop to two columns, then one.
try: Press the plus on a popular product: it goes in the bag, the bag's count rises and a note offers View bag.
Open a room card: the products page opens on that room's category.

regions.holds: The shop's name, Products and Rooms, search and the bag with its count
The room picture, the headline and two actions
Four rooms, then eight popular products with price, rating and Add to bag
The members' offer on the brand's tint

docs.summary: Every product, by category or search, sorted by popularity or price.
docs.narrow: The categories scroll in one row; the grid drops to two columns, then one.
try: Choose Lighting, then sort by lowest price.
Search for something the shop doesn't sell to see the empty result.

regions.holds: The title or the search, and how many products

docs.summary: One room: its picture, the products in it with Add to bag, then the other rooms.
docs.narrow: The picture stacks under the title; the products drop to two columns, then one.
try: Open Bedroom from the home page: the bedroom picture and its four products.
Add the lamp from the room, then open See all to browse its category.

regions.holds: Breadcrumbs, the room title, its line and picture
The products in the picture, then See all for its category

docs.summary: One product: its picture, price, rating, finish, quantity and Add to bag, with details, measurements and delivery.
docs.narrow: The picture sits above the details.
try: Pick another finish and a quantity of 2, then Add to bag.

regions.holds: The product on the shop's grey
Name, price, rating, finish, quantity, Add to bag

try: Change a quantity: the line and the total follow.
Remove everything to see the empty bag.

regions.holds: Each product, its finish, quantity and line price, with Remove

docs.summary: Contact, delivery address, delivery and payment in one page, then Place order.
docs.narrow: One column; the summary and Place order come last.
try: Press Place order with nothing filled in: each missing field says so and keeps what you typed.
Choose Click and collect: delivery becomes free in the total.
Fill everything in and place the order.
